text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing!
I took 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Having no one in front of me is a first! And this is my very first Winner's Circle!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks!
Trainer, I got 1st place~!
choice_data_list: How does it feel to take 1st place?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, well~...
After all, it's super fun!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That was way more fun than I thought!
I wanna take 1st place even more!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's enter lots of races!
I'll do my best again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To build up ability, just entering races
and gaining experience might be
a good goal to aim for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As she continues to run there,
she'll likely find the races
she truly wants to run herself.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hm?
Huh-huh-huh!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Look, over there!
Everyone from the shopping district is here!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking in Haru Urara's direction,
all the folks from the shopping district she's close with
had gathered together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chaaan!
Everyone, on three!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text: Congrats on your debut~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Rustle...)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Waah~!
It's a banner!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What the people from the shopping district held up
was a banner that read:
"Congratulations on your debut, Urara-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Urara-chan run at the racetrack
totally touched my heart!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local C
text_block_list.text: I'll keep cheering you on from now on too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup, thanks!
I'm gonna run a whole bunch!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Locals
text_block_list.text:
Ooh!
Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...She's only just made her debut,
yet it feels like a full-blown festival. The folks in the shopping district really do adore Haru Urara."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Then I must live up to those expectations.
Once more, I swore to make Haru Urara strong!"
